name: 77016 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77016 (Houston) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77016 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
